note: The argument is the same: if the tensor vanished, its translation shell law would make the free degree-four derivative vanish, contradicting `born`. [L] runs it for the re-centered average `j₀` (and the coefficient `w 3`) instead of T itself.

snippet.text:
have hn : j₀.val ≠ 0 := by
    intro ht; apply T.lit.born
    funext b
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext; intro i
    apply Table.field_ext S T.hT.laws.toSymmetric; intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ,hχ⟩ := exists_window x hx
    change (Bel C.book).useAt S x (Fin.cons ⟨5,T.T.W.deriv 4 b i⟩ q) =
      (Bel C.book).useAt S x (Fin.cons ⟨5,0⟩ q)
    rw [← hm.translation hx q hχ, ← translationFlux_apply hx hχ T.hT.smooth q,ht,map_zero, ← front_eval q x _ 0,map_zero]

proof_context.conclusion: `hn : j₀.val ≠ 0`: if `j₀ = 0`, its translation shell law makes `useAt` of `T.T.W.deriv 4 b i` vanish, contradicting `T.lit.born`.

snippet.text:
have hn : w 3 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hT.born (funext fun a => ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => (Bel L).field_ext hs.laws.toSymmetric (fun n q z hz => by
    obtain ⟨χ,hχ⟩ := exists_window z hz
    change (Bel L).useAt _ _ (Fin.cons ⟨4+1,T.W.deriv 4 a x⟩ q) = (Bel L).useAt _ _ (Fin.cons ⟨4+1,0⟩ q)
    rw [← h1.translation hz q hχ a 4 x,h0,zero_smul,← translationFlux_apply hz hχ hs.smooth,map_zero, ← front_eval q z (4+1) 0, map_zero]))

proof_context.conclusion: `hn : w 3 ≠ 0` by the same translation-shell argument against `hT.born` (`leaves T.W.deriv 4 ≠ 0`).
